newsitem.title: USA: Fortress Group to buy Woodside Homes.
newsitem.headline: Fortress Group to buy Woodside Homes.

text.p: The Fortress Group Inc said on Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of Woodside Homes.

Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, Woodside has homebuilding operations in Arizona, Nevada, and Utah and generated revenues of $110 million and pretax income of $14.8 million in the first nine months of 1996.
The deal is expected to close in December, the companies said.
Fortress Group, a Vienna, Va.-based homebuilder, reported sales of $198.2 million and profits of $0.70 a share for the first nine months of the year.
Terms of the deal were not immediately available.
